items.title: Government Simplifies Import Process for Drugs
items.whyInNews: The government has simplified the process for importing drugs for the purpose of inspection, test, or analysis under the Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945.
items.summary: The government has made the process easier by allowing the import of drugs without a license for inspection, test, or analysis. This move is expected to facilitate the import of drugs for research and development purposes. The Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945, regulate the import, manufacture, and sale of drugs in India.
